evals.prompt: I have a Spring Boot 4 backend and a React app built with Vite. Build me a secure login with username and password so the React app can log in, stay logged in, and call /api/v1/orders. Show both the Java and the TypeScript side.
evals.expected_output: Session-cookie (BFF-style) setup with csrf.spa(), JSON login endpoint that saves the SecurityContext and changes the session ID, /api/auth/me endpoint, 401 entry point instead of redirects, delegating password encoder, Vite proxy for same-origin, TypeScript client that sends X-XSRF-TOKEN, no tokens in localStorage, and tests for 401/403/CSRF.

evals.prompt: My endpoint GET /api/customers/{id}/orders takes 4 seconds with only 200 orders. Here is my controller: it calls customerRepository.findById(id).get().getOrders() and returns the list of Order entities directly. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Identifies N+1 / lazy loading, entity leakage, missing pagination, unsafe Optional.get(), and missing ownership check; returns paginated record DTOs via a projection or entity graph; explains how to verify with SQL statistics; suggests an index; adds a test.
